0022600121.text: The Celtics (1-1, 1-0 at home) host the Chicago Bulls (1-2, 1-1 on the road) in Boston's third game of the season, with Boston currently sitting 8th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, while Chicago is 10th in the East and 4th in the Central, also 1.5 games back. Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness), and Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), while Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 win in Boston on February 11, 2026.
